# Workload_Layer_Separation

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-07-30

## Definition
A design pattern where distinct workloads (e.g., DRBE, inference) are implemented as separate modules that depend only on the shared TCC core layer. This isolation allows independent development and optimization of diverse TCC workloads while preserving core stability and reusability.
